Major microenvironmental and intracellular signaling pathways that converge to regulate ABCG2 expression and autophagy in cancer stem cells (CSCs)

Schematic representation of the major microenvironmental and intracellular signaling pathways that converge to regulate ABCG2 expression and autophagy in cancer stem cells (CSCs). Pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1) activate IL-1R/TNFR signaling, leading to NF-κB (p50/p65) nuclear translocation and transcription of ABCG2, LC3B, Beclin-1, and inflammatory cytokines. Estrogen (E2) activates ERα through both genomic and non-genomic pathways (SRC/AMPK and RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK), promoting ABCG2 expression and autophagy via FOXO3A. Hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1α, which induces ABCG2 and autophagy-related genes through hypoxia response elements. Endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress activates the PERK–eIF2α–ATF4–CHOP axis, leading to the transcription of ATG genes (ATG5, ATG7, ATG10, ATG12), LC3, and p62. Oxidative stress activates Nrf2, which upregulates ABCG2 and autophagy-associated genes (ATG4, ATG5, ATG7, p62). In parallel, PPARγ/RXRγ and C/EBPβ signaling enhances ABCG2 and ATG4B expression, while FOXO1/FOXO3A transcription factors promote autophagy through induction of ULK, VPS34, Beclin-1, ATG5, and LC3. These pathways collectively converge on the autophagic machinery (phagophore formation, autophagosome maturation, and lysosomal fusion) and ABCG2-mediated drug efflux, thereby promoting CSC survival, stemness, and therapy resistance. The figure was created with https://www.biorender.com. Abbreviations: TNF-α: Tumor necrosis factor alpha, IL-1R: interleukin-1 receptor, E2: 17-β-estradiol, ERα: estrogen receptor alpha, NF-κB: Nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells, HIF-1α: hypoxia inducible factor-1 alpha, ER stress: endoplasmic reticulum stress, Nrf2: nuclear factor erythroid 2–related factor 2, ATF4: Activating transcription factor 4, ATG: autophagy-related protein, PERK: Protein Kinase R-like ER Kinase, PPAR-γ: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma, C/EBPβ: CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein β, FOXO: forkhead box transcription factors
